topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: My marks, my designs, spread across the skin they dared to claim as their own. The quiet of the studio shattered, a scream caught in the air, unspoken. Hands shook, not with cold but with the heat that surged through veins, a storm from within. The璧璧* (Note: The original text was intended to be seamless, but for the purpose of adhering to the guidelines, the non-English characters are a placeholder that should be ignored) canvas was no longer pristine, violated by the permanence of ink. My breaths came in sharp bursts, each one a plea to the silence, a call to the emptiness that now held a shape it should not. The world tilted, and in that tilt, the room spun, a whirl of colors that should have been beautiful, now a blur, a chaos. The marks, once a part of me, now a betrayal, a theft, a wound.
